name: Inject source restored entry
info:
Creates a synthetic 'source restored' system entry and prepares it for the standard pipeline.

### Input
`msg.metadata` — connection metadata with the recovered source client and target client.

### Trigger
Only reached via a switch node that confirms `msg.wasDown === true`.

### Output
`msg.payload` — bridge-format entry `{ id, text, timestamp, author, files: [], labels: [] }`
`msg.metadata.source` — overwritten with the parat-bridge sentinel so `Client to bridge entry` passes it through without transformation.

### Pipeline continuation
Output feeds into `Client to bridge entry` (parat-bridge path) → `Attach metadata and prune` → `log queue`.
